concerns: Supplier photos are subject to lighting and perspective; the apparent flatness of the face should be confirmed with a true orthogonal cross-section photograph before final approval.

Texture/colour match (dark brushed linear grain, low gloss) appears consistent, but the profile geometry conflict must be resolved first.
